examples.arabic: ماما قالت يا بابا لو سمحت صلح النور
examples.english: Mama said: "Dad, please fix the light."
examples.transliteration: Mama qalet: "Ya baba, law samaht salah el-noor."

examples.arabic: ايوه بالظبط ده هو امبارح صلح اللابتوب بتاعه وكان فيه مشكلة كبيرة انا متأكدة إنه هيعرف يصلحها
examples.english: Yes, exactly him. Yesterday he fixed his laptop, and it had a big problem. I'm sure he'll know how to fix it.
examples.transliteration: Aywa bel-ẓabṭ, da howa embareh sallaha el-laptop beta'o w kan feeh moshkela kebeera, ana met'akkeda inno haye'raf yessalahha.
